artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder, and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hieronymus Bosch
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Armed Four-Master Sailing towards a Port
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a large sailing ship on wavy waters with full sails and intricate rigging. The horizon is in the lower third with a distant landmass to the right, featuring buildings and birds in the sky. The precise lines depict movement in the water and sky. The color palette is monochrome with shades of grey and black defining textures and forms. Other smaller ships are visible in the distance, and the sky has swirling clouds rendered with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Armed Four-Master Putting Out to Sea
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a scene featuring a ship sailing near a castle-like shore. The composition shows buildings along the coast with towers and spires reaching up to the sky. The style of the artwork is etching, with intricate cross-hatched lines depicting texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia. Waves are detailed with lines to convey motion. Smaller boats with sails are visible closer to the shore, and there are fluffy clouds and birds in the sky.

artworks.title: A Fleet of Galleys Escorted by a Caravel
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate engraving of a maritime scene. A large ship with billowing sails is in the center, with smaller boats around it. The horizon is high, with clouds partially covering the sun. The engraving is detailed with fine lines depicting the textures of clouds, waves, and the ships. The color scheme is sepia, giving the scene a vintage look.

artworks.title: Three Caravels in a Rising Squall with Adrion on a Dolphin
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with three large sailing ships navigating choppy waters. The perspective is elevated, giving a wide view of the ships and sea. The horizon is low, with swirling clouds in the vast sky. The style is detailed with fine linework, creating texture and depth in the rendering of the ships and sea. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and beige. Fantastical sea creatures, such as a human-like figure and an open-mouthed fish, are seen in the water. Dynamic cloud formations in the sky add to the sense of drama and motion.

artworks.title: The Drunkard Pushed into the Pig Sty
artworks.artist: after Pieter Bruegel the Elder

artworks.title: Everyman
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a detailed print of a cluttered scene with various bags, baskets, containers, and strange objects piled on the ground outside of a building. Some of the objects include a chessboard, a book, a bucket, dice, playing cards, scissors, cushions, and other tools. Three men seem to be rummaging through this pile, opening sacks and baskets and bending down to look in them. In the center, one of the men seems to hold a lantern as he walks among the objects, looking down. On the left, stairs seem to lead up to the building. Two people stand on these stairs, seeming engaged in tug-of-war with a long strip of cloth. Next to them, on the wall of the building, seems to be a poster showing a man standing among several broken and discarded objects, with a line of text at the bottom. In the background on the right, there is an open, outdoor area with a tree, a distant building, and a tall fence with several tents in front of it. A large army seems to have gathered around the tents, some holding weapons and some holding flags. Below the print are several lines of text.

artworks.title: The Festival of Saint George
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a village scene with numerous figures engaging in various activities. The image depicts a bustling rural landscape, possibly a village festival or market day. The foreground shows figures pushing carts, wrestling, and playing games. In the background, there are thatched buildings, trees, windmills, and people involved in different tasks, creating a busy atmosphere. The drawing features detailed etching lines to emphasize the lively scene.

artworks.title: Heads of a Peasant Man and Woman
artworks.artist: Adriaen Brouwer after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays two side-by-side portraits of individuals in separate oval frames. On the left, the person is in profile, with distinct facial features and wearing a flat cap. On the right, the person faces forward with a somber expression and a cloth covering the head. The background is a cross-hatched pattern typical of engravings. The bottom of the image includes text with artistic attribution.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Mercury and Psyche
artworks.artist: Attributed to Simon Novellanus after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a landscape from an elevated point of view. It shows a river, fields, and hills stretching into the distant horizon. The hills are lined with a castle on the left. A river winds through the scene, leading from the bottom left to the mid-ground. In the foreground, figures are seated looking at the view, with a sailboat on the river nearby. In the distance, there are trees and buildings, adding depth to the landscape. The engraving is monochromatic with fine lines and shading, creating texture and contrast. A figure with wings is flying in the sky. The engraving is detailed, bringing the historical scene to life.

artworks.title: The Wedding of Mopsus and Nisa
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with various figures in a detailed landscape. Tall trees and village buildings are visible in the background. The composition appears to be an engraving with meticulous line work and a monochromatic color palette. Several figures are shown engaging in what appears to be a performance or play, with others in dynamic poses throughout the scene.

artworks.title: The Thin Kitchen
artworks.artist: Flemish 17th Century, after Pieter van der Heyden, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.4 x 28.9 cm (8 13/16 x 11 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a kitchen scene with various food preparation elements and figures. The kitchen is detailed and crowded with various kitchenware like pots, pans, and baskets. The figures have exaggerated features and are engaged in lively actions. Above them, musical notes are visible on a shelf. The scene is lively and bustling, filled with action and movement. This painting is in the style of Pieter Bruegel the Elder, known for intricate depictions of everyday scenes.

artworks.title: Saint James and the Magician Hermogenes
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a busy harvest scene from an elevated perspective. People are harvesting wheat with scythes, carrying jugs, and balancing baskets of fruits and vegetables on their heads. In the background, workers continue to harvest in the fields. A church spire is visible on a hillside with trees and rustic buildings. The landscape extends to a calm river in the distance. The image is an intricate engraving in monochrome, depicting the intensity and rhythm of the summer harvest.

artworks.title: Village Fair at Hoboken
artworks.artist: Attributed to Franz Hogenberg after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.3 x 40 cm (11 9/16 x 15 3/4 in.)

artworks.title: The Big Fish Eat the Little Fish
artworks.artist: Jan Thiel (publisher)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various activities with giant fish and smaller human-like figures interacting. The drawing is filled with intricate details showcasing a chaotic interaction where the larger fish dominate the scene, being handled, dissected, and surrounded by these creatures. The composition is dense, filled with dynamic movements and various groups engaged in different tasks, closely attending to the oversized fish. The entirety is framed by text panels that provide a narrative or commentary. The overall imagery suggests an allegorical interpretation, possibly critiquing or depicting moral or social themes. The attention to detail and the complex interplay between figures and fish indicate an intention to convey more profound stories or messages through visual metaphor.

artworks.title: Everyman
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with oversized sacks and scattered objects. The environment is cluttered with bags marked with symbols, surrounded by items like musical instruments, tools, and manuscripts. In the background, there are tents and buildings. The foreground shows jumbled objects, including a chessboard and open books. The title "Amor habendi." and a Latin inscription below suggest a theme related to want or greed. The intricate linework and detailed rendering give the scene a sense of complexity and movement, highlighting the disorderly accumulation of items.

artworks.title: The Man with the Moneybag and His Flatterers
artworks.artist: Johann Theodor de Bry after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This print features a large creature with a humanoid upper body and a human face with a headscarf. They are sitting down and leaning forward, with their body facing away from us, towards the left, and their head turned over their shoulder to look towards us with a somber expression. Near the bottom-right corner, small people crawl on their hands and knees on the ground, heading into a square opening in the creature's lower body, between their hips and lower back. The large creature’s arms are on the left, holding a long back with coins spilling out of it on the ground. At the bottom of the print is a line of Latin text. The background is minimal, with low hills and an empty sky decorated with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Alpine Landscape
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an intricately detailed print depicting a vast landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is placed high in the image, allowing for an expansive view of the terrain below. To the far distance, the landscape rises into cliffs and outcroppings, with some small buildings and structures perched upon them. The point of view encompasses a large area, revealing a winding path that ascends towards a rocky formation. The print is created using fine, detailed line work typical of etching, with hatching and cross-hatching employed to render the textures of the rocky surfaces and the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on the contrast between black ink and the light tan color of the paper to portray depth and texture. Close to us, on the right, a group of travelers with packs interact with one another, while a cluster of trees adds a delicate balance to the scene. Beyond, a valley with a narrow river meanders through the landscape, drawing the eye toward the dramatic rock formations and distant buildings. In the sky, a few birds are seen flying amidst clouds.

artworks.title: Plaustrum Belgicum (The Belgian Wagon)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 32.2 x 42.4 cm (12 11/16 x 16 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with figures in the foreground. In the foreground, there are two people and a covered wagon. In the background, there is a town nestled among hills with mountains in the far background. The sky has swirling clouds. The scene is created using an etching technique with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of black and grey. In the far distance, there are ships near the town.

artworks.title: Insidiosus Auceps (The Crafty Bird-Catcher)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed mountainous landscape with a mix of rugged terrain and human settlement. The scene shows mountains, a horizon meeting the sky, two birds flying above distant mountains, people, horses, paths, buildings, and a village in a valley. The artwork features intricate line work characteristic of etching, emphasizing texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Large Alpine Landscape
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a high vantage point, revealing a vast, rugged terrain. The horizon is high, emphasizing the depth of the view. In the distance, rocky mountain formations rise, with a castle-like structure on a hill. The artwork features detailed line work, emphasizing textures of rocky surfaces, trees, and streams. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of gray for contrast and depth. Near the viewer on the right, a figure on horseback overlooks the valley. A winding path or stream guides the eye through the scene, highlighting small clusters of trees and buildings.

artworks.title: Solicitudo Rustica (Rustic Concerns)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a valley, hills with trees and houses, distant mountains, two figures under a tree, one chopping wood, and a horse-drawn cart near buildings. The sky has scattered birds. The intricate etching technique uses fine lines and delicate shading in shades of brown.

artworks.title: Nundinae Rusticorum (Rustic Market)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is placed towards the upper third of the composition, with distant hills and a soft gradient of clouds in the sky. The engraving technique shows detailed line work in the trees, houses, and landscape contour. A path winds between tall trees, with a fence and small buildings nearby. Rolling hills with more trees and buildings, including a church with a steeple, are visible. In the distance, the landscape continues with more hills and small buildings hinting at a town. The overall color palette is monochrome, using varying black and grey tones for depth, shading, and contrast.
